newsitem.title: USA: Labor Ready August same-store sales rise.
newsitem.headline: Labor Ready August same-store sales rise.

text.p: Labor Ready Inc., a provider of temporary workers to the light industrial, construction and small business markets, Tuesday said sales rose 52 percent last month to $14.8 million from $9.7 million a year ago.
Same-store sales for August increased 16 percent over same-store sales for the same period last year.

Year-to-date sales through August were $89.3 million, an increase of 79 percent on sales of $50.0 million for the corresponding period of 1995. Same-store year-to-date sales through August increased 31 percent over same-store sales for the same period last year.

"Our same-store sales comparisons are less than planned," the company said. "This performance can be attributed mainly to this year's aggressive expansion plans for opening 94 new dispatch offices in pioneer markets.

"Our focus on the acceleration of new office development came at the expense of existing office sales efforts, customer follow-up, staffing, training and control, all of which have been a major impact on driving same-store revenues," it added.
